_comment: ARMOURED kit, the hero piece: the armour belt that runs down the straight edge of a hull. Two stacked slabs, a narrow light rail standing on a wider dark base, so what carries at range is the value break rather than the profile. It is 0.98 cells LONG, which is why it raises the footprint budget: a greeble stands dead centre of its plate (no jitter), so a piece that spans its whole cell meets the next one in the run and a row of them reads as ONE continuous strake instead of a dashed line. 0.98 and not 1.0 leaves a hair of clearance at the seam so two neighbours never share a coincident face. Turned with align: Run, so +Z is the long axis, down the edge.
